Chapter 194: Chapter 3 Martial Tao Shouldn’t Be So Trivial (Please Subscribe)

“It’s so heavy.”

Lin Yuan looked down at the black suitcase again.

It was only fifty centimeters in length and width, but it weighed at least ten tons.

“The handover is complete.”

“Then I’ll be taking my leave first.”

The man in the black uniform gave a slight smile.

...

He turned and left.

From start to finish.

This was a seemingly ordinary delivery and receipt of goods.

If Lin Yuan had not been forewarned, he wouldn’t have thought more about it.

“What exactly did teacher send me?”

Lin Yuan carried the black suitcase back to the main building.

The weight of ten tons was naturally not a problem for Lin Yuan’s current physical condition.

Lin Yuan was surprised just now because he did not expect the black suitcase to weigh ten tons.

“Let’s open it and see.”

Lin Yuan returned to the underground training ground.

BEEP—

He went through fingerprint, pupil, and soul wave authentication again.

The black suitcase slowly opened.

What came into view was a fist-sized black-gold box.

Lin Yuan could tell that the suitcase’s whopping ten-ton weight was almost entirely due to this black-gold box.

CLICK.

With all the previous verifications,

Lin Yuan easily opened the black-gold box this time.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan saw that in the center of the black-gold box lay a ‘stone’ the size of a pinky fingernail.

The ‘stone’ was crimson.

Looking at this ‘stone’, Lin Yuan felt as though he was observing a perpetual star.

“This…”

Lin Yuan closely observed the fingernail-sized ‘stone.’

Every detail of it, the textures on its surface, the traces, all stirred a huge tidal wave in Lin Yuan’s heart.

“This is the rule, the essence of the World’s rules…”

Lin Yuan felt excited.

If it were another Evolver, they might not recognize what this ‘stone’ was.

Even some Sixth Rank Evolvers might not recognize it.

But Lin Yuan was different.

Having experienced the Divine Arms World.

Lin Yuan was extremely sensitive to the essence rules of the World.

This fingernail-sized ‘stone’ was far from manifesting the essential rules outwardly.

In the Divine Arms World, even the smallest piece of a Divine Weapon, the volume of rules essence it contained, far exceeded that of this ‘stone.’

But this is the Main World.

A single hair from an elephant weighs infinitely more than an ant.

Not to mention the difference between the Main World and the Divine Arms World is more than that between an elephant and an ant?

This ‘stone’, far from outwardly manifesting essential rules, barely even qualifies as an imprint, merely tainted with a bit of the essence of the rules.

Yet to Lin Yuan, it felt more significant than all the Divine Weapons in the Divine Arms World combined.

Hotness.

Vastness.

Light.

Many essences manifested on this ‘stone.’

“With this stone as a reference for my enlightenment, it will be much easier for me to forge ahead on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and break through to the Sixth Rank…”

It’s like having a math problem that Lin Yuan could only solve slowly before, but now, he has a plethora of related reference materials.

Solving this problem will definitely be much easier.

Even with all these supplementary materials, they are immensely helpful for Lin Yuan in solving the next problem and the ones after that.

“Teacher.”

Lin Yuan connected to the Virtual World.

He arrived at the palace of the Chikun Star Lord.

“You’re here?”

The Chikun Star Lord looked at Lin Yuan with an expectant expression, “Have you seen that thing? How do you feel about it?”

“Teacher,”

Lin Yuan hesitated, “It’s too precious, I can’t accept…”

Even though Lin Yuan was unclear about the value of items related to the rules in the Main World.

Solely in transporting this ‘stone,’ the Chikun Star Lord had utilized the S-grade encryption of the trillion-dollar Shuntong Group.

It was clear that its value was far beyond a trillion.

It was even an invaluable treasure that money couldn’t buy.

“You are my disciple, what can’t you accept?”

The Chikun Star Lord said nonchalantly, “Besides, at my current level, items like this are of no use to me anyway. Rather than letting them waste away, it’s better to use them…”

“Thank you, Teacher.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

He also understood that the Chikun Star Lord’s words were merely to comfort him.

Not needing them himself, they could have been sold or even traded for something he needed.

“How about it?”

“What do you think of that stone?”

The Chikun Star Lord continued to ask.

“It has inspired me greatly,”

Lin Yuan said earnestly.

“That’s good.”

A smile appeared on the Chikun Star Lord’s face, “Good disciple, if I were to forcefully guide you, it would only restrict and fix your path.”

“That stone, a Rule Crystal, contains the essence that is a boundless Great Dao.”

“If you can fully comprehend the mysteries contained within the stone, surpassing the Sixth Rank should be no problem,”

The Chikun Star Lord spoke.

…

Returning from the Chikun Star Lord’s place.

Lin Yuan’s gaze once again fell on the fingernail-sized stone.

“It’s so profound…”

Lin Yuan was almost addicted.

The crimson stone, related to the Taiyang Rule, Lin Yuan studied it carefully, able to continuously enhance his understanding of the Taiyang Rule.

Just like that.

Lin Yuan devoted a significant portion of each day to reflecting on this stone.

For the rest of his time, he continued perfecting the Martial Path Evolutionary Path and pondered how to break through to the Sixth Rank.

Yes.

Lin Yuan had long possessed the ability to break through to the Sixth Rank.

But exactly where to start required careful consideration.

Once he began the breakthrough to the Sixth Rank, his soul would actively align with his Evolutionary Path.

This was crucial.

If his soul achieved perfect alignment with his Evolutionary Path, he could step into the Sixth Rank.

Advancing from Fifth Rank to Sixth Rank isn’t an instantaneous or quick process.

It takes time, quickly a few years or slowly hundreds or thousands of years.

Many Fifth Rank Evolvers at their peak struggle with soul alignment, unable to step into the Sixth Rank for hundreds or even thousands of years.
